wiki.title: Barbara Dittrich
wiki.extract: Barbara Dittrich (born May 21, 1964) is an American Republican politician from Waukesha County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 99th Assembly district since 2025; she previously represented the 38th Assembly district from 2019 to 2025.
